values.title: Environments
values.summary: Production, staging and preview branches: isolated copies of your database, keys and functions.
values.body:
## What an environment is

An environment is a fully isolated copy of your project, with its own database, API keys, secrets and function deployments. Every project starts with `development` and `production`.

## Default environments

Environment

Used for

Data

`development`

Local work and `tessera push`

Seed data, safe to reset

`staging`

Pre-release checks and QA

Copy of production, anonymised

`production`

Your live app

Real customer data

## Switching environments

```
npx tessera env list
npx tessera env use staging
```

Production is protected

Schema changes reach production only through a reviewed migration. `tessera push` never targets production directly.
